title: Fix GDPR
body:
## What kind of an issue is this?

- [x] Feature request


## What is the expected behaviour?

Comply with GDPR.

Need to find out all of what we have to do to comply and how we want to do it.


## Other information

Some useful links.

https://www.eugdpr.org/
https://www.datatilsynet.no/regelverk-og-skjema/veiledere/hva-betyr/
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body: This is mostly a discussion issue, which we've talked about ever since it was made. We're working on a larger project (a bit late, yeah) which will handle it, and smaller issues will be made for that in turn.

scope: Current retrievable issue body and issue comments; not the original study's historical snapshot. Linked pages and attachments are not fetched.
